Here is a comprehensive guide to the **soft brand / collection hotel brands** that an owner should consider for affiliation while preserving their hotel's individuality:

## 🏨 What Is a Soft Brand Collection?

citations.cited_text: According to STR, “A soft brand is an affiliation between an independent hotel and a hotel chain which can provide hotel operators with lower costs an...
citations.title: Hard facts about soft brands | Hotel Management

content.text: A soft brand is an affiliation between an independent hotel and a hotel chain that provides hotel operators with lower costs and added flexibility compared with standard franchise agreements. The arrangement allows independent hotels to retain their identities while benefiting from a chain's marketing and distribution resources, including access to global loyalty programs, volume discounts on procurement, better terms with OTAs, and other economies of scale.

citations.cited_text: It allows a hotel to retain its independent name, signage, and management (satisfying the guest’s need for uniqueness) while plugging into the Global ...
citations.title: Should Your Independent Hotel Join a Soft Brand Collection? - White Sky Hotel Consultancy & Training

content.text: It allows a hotel to retain its independent name, signage, and management — satisfying the guest's need for uniqueness — while plugging into the Global Distribution System (GDS), loyalty programme, and sales engine of a major chain, satisfying the owner's need for revenue stability.

citations.cited_text: Unlike traditional or hard brands, soft brands allow owners to maintain their property’s uniqueness and service philosophy, while reaping the rewards ...
citations.title: Softening up: Why hotels turn to soft brands and affiliation networks - HOTELSMag.com

content.text: Unlike traditional or hard brands, soft brands allow owners to maintain their property's uniqueness and service philosophy, while reaping the rewards of a large commercial engine.
